newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - WPL Holdings raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - WPL Holdings raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said Wednesday it upgraded its near-term rating on WPL Holdings Inc to market perform from under perform. Its long-term rating remains market perform.

-- EVEREN said since it downgraded the stock to under perform on August 21, shares have declined six percent. "We now believe this negative expectation is reflected in the stock price," it said in a report.
-- Earnings estimates remain $2.35 a share for fiscal 1996 and $2.40 for fiscal 1997.
-- WPL is part of a proposed three-way merger with Interstate Power Co and IES Industries Inc.
